stance_rationale: covariance.parquet is PSD and the exported security-level condition number passes mechanically, but the risk package is not safe optimizer input. The package narratively identifies market/tail/crowding risks while the Sigma artifact under-represents common market covariance, silently passes severe stress breaches, and lacks required schedule/challenge artifacts.

sigma_audit.method_selected: Ledoit-Wolf constant-correlation shrinkage for Omega; Sigma = B Omega B' + diag(D)

regime_sigma_audit.crisis_fallback_method: none; CRISIS n=64, but labels use full-sample benchmark-return quantiles and no t-1 expanding regime lag
regime_sigma_audit.comment: Sample size is not the main failure; PIT labeling and switch-rate control fail. CAUTION regime is absent despite the prompt checklist.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: FAIL: Q04_Piotroski_F hhi_top=0.972, M05_Trended_Mom=0.799, and M01_Mom_12_1=0.425 exceed the RF-R3 0.40 HHI flag band; TDC vs PG2 is not computed.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: alpha_scores.parquet has 2554 rows but only one as_of_date and no Date/sig_date time-series panel; this blocks schedule-level verification.
regime_correlation.parquet is produced with full-sample bm_ret quantiles and no t-1 expanding percentile lag; estimated switch rate is 59.6%, above the 30% turnover-management band.
No FRED/ECOS external macro series are consumed in the risk artifacts reviewed; benchmark and RAWDATA are local market series.
_factor_return_panel.parquet is built from load_month_factors() and next-month realized returns for 256 months.
_risk_build_panel.R calls load_month_factors(sig_d, factor_names=FACTORS); no direct monthly factor parquet load was found.

critical_concerns.description: The Sigma artifact under-represents the package's own main risk: market beta. B Omega B' explains only 7.95% of EW portfolio variance, average off-diagonal correlation is 0.0017, and model EW annual vol is 8.34% versus realized CORE annual vol 21.75%; market_var_share=67.18% is only a separate regression narrative, not embedded as common covariance for the optimizer.

Tail/stress gates are silently overridden: CVaR95=11.92% breaches the 2.5% monthly cap, GFC stress loss=-34.33% breaches RF-R4 >25%, and _risk_assemble.R sets stress_policy_ok = all(...) || TRUE. This is a direct process-honesty failure.

Crowding is incorrectly cleared. The package says RF-R3-CLEAR because crowding_score <0.75, but the role prompt flags HHI >0.40; Q04 hhi_top=0.972, M05=0.799, and M01=0.425. TDC vs PG2 is also missing.

Regime covariance diagnostics are not PIT-safe: regime labels use full-sample benchmark-return quantiles, no t-1 lag or expanding percentile, CAUTION is absent, and estimated switch rate is 59.6% versus the <30% management target.

Post-shrink Omega remains ill-conditioned at 121.58 despite the <=100 checklist threshold, while method shopping only compares sample versus Ledoit-Wolf. Gerber/RMT/DCC alternatives are not evaluated despite fat-tail evidence.

Required verification artifacts are missing or path-mismatched: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260614_002 and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260614_002 do not exist, weights.csv is absent, and no risk_challenge_note.md/final risk_package/optimization_package is present. Schedule-level Sigma and No Silent Override cannot be verified.

alpha_scores.parquet is a single-date snapshot, so risk uses current 60-name/static B exposures for historical residual variance instead of a proper Date x Ticker score/exposure panel. This preserves the Iter 4 single-snapshot failure mode for schedule validation.

Risk diagnostics cross the role boundary by recommending compact DQV6/drop momentum. Risk can report covariance burden and alpha-risk mismatch, but factor deletion is alpha/optimizer scope and should be framed as an objection, not a risk recommendation.

supporting_arguments: covariance.parquet is present at stage_artifacts/WT-D20260614_002, 60x60, symmetric, PD, min eigenvalue 0.0861, condition number 29.56.
The factor-return panel covers 256 months from 2005-01 to 2026-04 and is built through load_month_factors(), supporting C12/C15 for the factor-return construction.
Hill alpha=2.65 does not trigger RF-R6, and the active-correlation correction versus the incumbent is useful diagnostic information.
unresolved_disputes: Whether cond_post_shrink should be judged on exported security Sigma only or also on Omega; Sigma passes at 29.56, Omega fails the <=100 threshold at 121.58.
TDC vs PG2 active book is not computed, so crowding cannot be fully cleared.
weights.csv is absent, so the requested schedule-level risk verification cannot be performed.
The package calls factor_coverage_gt_80 'N/A', but the role prompt requires factor coverage R2 >=30%; observed mean factor_var_explained is about 1.06% and factor-block variance share is 7.95%.
weakest_assumption: A Sigma model with almost no common covariance can be authoritative for optimizer use while the dominant 67% market-beta risk is handled only as a narrative regression outside the covariance matrix.
rebuttal_required: Rebuild Sigma with an explicit market/common-risk component or a validated shrinkage stock-return covariance, then reconcile model EW vol and realized CORE vol.
Remove the stress_policy_ok || TRUE override and produce an infeasibility_report for CVaR95 and RF-R4 stress breaches.
Provide weights.csv and verify schedule-level exposure, PSD, condition number, turnover, max names, long-only, and per-name weight caps.
Recompute regime labels with t-1 expanding thresholds, include CAUTION or justify its removal, and report switch-rate controls.
Compute TDC vs PG2 active book and flag HHI >0.40 directly rather than clearing by crowding_score only.
Extend method shopping to Gerber/RMT/DCC-Copula or explain why heavy-tail alternatives are infeasible.
Produce risk_challenge_note.md documenting alpha concerns answered without factor-mix override.
rationalization_red_flags: standalone book-marginal ΔIR is NOT structurally ~0
Sigma PSD, cond 29.6 (<<500), no shrinkage escalation needed
risk recommendation to optimizer: momentum exposure is a pure covariance burden -> compact DQV6

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Claude's draft correctly computes several diagnostics, but the external risk view cannot approve a covariance package that omits dominant market common risk from Sigma, hardcodes stress pass-through, and lacks schedule artifacts.

risk_specific_questions: If market beta explains 67% of portfolio variance, why is there no explicit market factor or stock-return shrinkage covariance in Sigma?
How can optimizer safely use covariance.parquet when EW model vol is 8.34% versus realized CORE vol 21.75%?
Why is stress_policy_ok hardcoded true despite GFC -34.33%, ratehike2022 -24.68%, and CVaR95 -11.92%?
What exact TDC definition versus PG2 active book will be used, and why was HHI >0.40 not flagged?
Are regime labels intended as optimizer inputs? If yes, where is the t-1 expanding percentile implementation and switch-rate budget?
